title: App freezing on 3.1.0.2
symptom: When tapping on the AAPS icon, the app shows a white screen with the AAPS logo for 5 seconds, then closes. On second tap, the app launches and 'aaps started' note is displayed on graph.
evidence_quote: Had an app freezing on 3.1.0.2, thought it should have been fixed: when tapping on aaps icon, got white screen with aaps logo for 5 seconds, than this screen closed, on second tap app lunched and "aaps started" note now displayed on graph
